before.description: abrdn ETF holdings to Watchlist. A single-file client-side tool reading ./api/aberdeen (official Aberdeen gateway, SEC N-PORT holdings fallback, Yahoo history/dividends) into a searchable ETF/asset-class catalog with per-fund tabs, watchlist, CSV/TXT export. TailwindCSS, dark mode, Bun updater.
